title: Bridge policy registry validation across protected moves
goal: Let the previous trusted base classify schema-valid head policy paths and reproducible projection targets during the CP11j protected relocation.
acceptanceCriteria: Head policy and authority registries are read from the explicit head commit and validated with base schemas.
Head-registered policy additions and base-registered removals remain zero-comparator policy-weakening obligations.
Only base-regenerated derived projection targets are excluded from policy-change obligations.
Invalid registries, unregistered files and uncovered moves fail closed.
Trusted Diff and trusted-component candidate validation pass with exact authorization consumption.
